citation: B04: the mod's OWN quest, not an override. Objectives s20 'Talk to Tythis', s30 'Win the brawl against Tythis', s40 'Threaten Tythis', s50 'Talk to Svana'; s100 is the CompleteQuest terminal. honorable_duel is for the brawl, which is a fist-fight challenge rather than a killing. RUNTIME-VERIFY: every stage in this quest is tier B or C - objectives only, no journal text anywhere - so the outcome is read from the objective chain and must be confirmed in game.
branch_note: Single outcome. The mod also overrides vanilla FreeformRiften11, but that override carries vanilla's own Marks-of-Dibella structure and adds nothing, so it is not rowed - core owns it.
